digest.component_or_area: project.review-phase-boundaries code-review criterion (rebar project extension surface)
propositions: Author a project-owned code-review criterion enforcing the four-pass find/verify/decide/coach boundaries so agents cannot leak severity, drop/block policy, or remediation into the wrong pass.
The criterion is a single-turn Pass-1 finder that emits grounded evidence only, carries no severity or confidence, and always leaves suggested_fix empty.
Routing activates the criterion for code_review with exec 1-TURN, block_threshold 0.90, and blocking_enabled false (advisory, recorded for pilot but non-blocking).
A balanced twelve-case corpus (RP-F1..RP-F6 must fire, RP-N1..RP-N6 must not fire) validates phase-ownership guards, instruction-vs-documentation distinction, and grandfathered-debt handling.
A live three-run eval must achieve recall 1.0, false_accept 0.0, agreement 1.0, kappa >= 0.70, and per-case stability >= 2/3, recorded on the ticket.
The implementation must be entirely project-owned, changing only .rebar/ assets, gitignore exceptions, criterion-specific tests, and the docs subsection, adding no core special case.
